entries.text: The published corpus adds TPC-DS OBT SF1 bundles for DuckDB, DataFusion and ClickHouse Local with the lettered `14a`/`14b`, `23a`/`23b` and `24a`/`24b` ids. ClickHouse Local on chDB 4.1.6 cannot run Q41 and Q44. Submission validation, the corpus validator and the Explorer accept that bundle as clean only for those two ids on that benchmark and platform.
